cases.name: Mallory LeeAnn Dunnivant
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a resident of Mt. Morris and a graduate of Atherton High School.  Mallory worked at Montague Elementary School where she was a huge influence. She loved kids and helping them. Mallory was caring, selfless, had a heart of a lion and wore her heart on her sleeve."

She worked as a paraprofessional at Montague Elementary School in the Mt. Morris Consolidated Schools district, where she would often greet students as they were coming to or from school. In a letter to parents, the school district described Dunnivant as “a positive influence to those who knew her and will be missed deeply.”
